actions.label: lineDiscount
actions.expression: ROUND(IF(discountTypeLine == "percent", MIN(lineGross, lineGross * (MAX(0, discountValueLine) / 100)), IF(discountTypeLine == "fixed", MIN(lineGross, MAX(0, discountValueLine)), 0)), 2)

actions.label: orderDiscount
actions.expression: ROUND(IF(discountType == "percent", MIN(netSubtotal, netSubtotal * (MAX(0, discountValue) / 100)), IF(discountType == "fixed", MIN(netSubtotal, MAX(0, discountValue)), 0)), 2)

actions.label: vatLineDiscount
actions.expression: ROUND(IF(discountTypeLine == "percent", MIN(vatLineGross, vatLineGross * (MAX(0, discountValueLine) / 100)), IF(discountTypeLine == "fixed", MIN(vatLineGross, MAX(0, discountValueLine)), 0)), 2)

actions.label: Reject Invalid Price
actions.errorMessage: Price override must be greater than zero

actions.label: Reject Invalid Amount
actions.errorMessage: Petty cash amount must be greater than zero

actions.label: 5. Calculate Discount
actions.expression: IF(discountType == "percent", ROUND(grossSubtotal * MAX(0, discountValue) / 100, 2), IF(discountType == "fixed", MIN(grossSubtotal, MAX(0, discountValue)), 0))

actions.label: 12. Resolve VAT Rate
actions.expression: IF(!vatEnabled || vatApplicable == false, 0, IF(lineVatRate > 0, lineVatRate / 100, defaultVatRate / 100))

actions.label: Invalid Misc Line
actions.errorMessage: Misc item price and quantity must be greater than zero
